name: Agent finds it
title: John needs a dataset.
body: His AI agent finds a useful developer dataset for $10. John wants the file, but he doesn't want to hand over control of his wallet.
voiceover: John's agent finds a dataset. With RouteTill, John controls the purchase, and payment and delivery are verified. The seller's price is ten dollars.

name: No blank check
title: His money. His decision.
body: An agent shouldn't have unrestricted spending power. John wants to buy this one file, not give an agent permission to spend whenever it wants.
voiceover: An agent can suggest the purchase, but it cannot approve it or control John's wallet. One file. No blank check.

name: John says yes
title: One file. One approval.
body: John sees the seller, the $10 price and the file he's getting. He sets a maximum source spend of 11 USDC and approves this one purchase.
voiceover: John reviews the seller's ten USDC price. He types eleven into his source spending limit, then enters his refund wallet. ETH gas is separate. He reviews and approves this purchase only.

name: Payment verified
title: Paid on Arbitrum. Received on Base.
body: John sends about $10.11 from his Arbitrum wallet. NEAR Intents handles the cross-chain payment, and RouteTill verifies that the merchant received exactly $10 on Base.
voiceover: For our completed mainnet purchase, John paid from Arbitrum. NEAR Intents settled across chains so the merchant received ten USDC on Base. SUCCESS alone is not enough. RouteTill independently checked the recipient, token, amount and finalized receipt.

name: File + proof
title: Delivered. With proof.
body: RouteTill verifies the merchant payment, delivers the correct dataset exactly once, and issues a signed Purchase Passport anyone can check.
voiceover: Only after the merchant receipt was verified did RouteTill deliver the file. One entitlement. The exact approved bytes. The signed Purchase Passport connects the approval, payment and file digest. Its independent verifier passed twelve checks.

name: Break-It Lab
title: Five security checks. No real funds.
body: Judges can also try five security checks. RouteTill rejects changed recipients, over-limit payments and reused approvals. Twenty notifications produce one entitlement. Tampered evidence fails verification.
voiceover: Try five no-funds security checks. Changed recipients, excess spending and reused approval are rejected. Twenty notifications produce one entitlement, and tampered proof fails.

name: RouteTill
title: One purchase. The proof to keep.
body: John got the right file. The seller got paid. And RouteTill has the proof.
voiceover: The seller was paid. John got the right file. Explore the demo, try checkout, and inspect RouteTill's proof.
